Convert between SRA, GEO, BioSample and BioProject accessions

Source: R/sradb.R
sra_convert.Rd

The successor to SRAdb::sraConvert() and GEOmetadb::geoConvert(). Accessions of any supported type, mixed freely, are mapped to the requested types.

Usage

sra_convert(con, in_acc, out_type = c("study", "sample", "experiment", "run"))

geo_convert(con, in_acc, out_type = c("gse", "gpl", "gsm"))

Arguments

con

A connection from omicidx_connect(), or an omicidx_db().

in_acc

character. Accessions to convert; in_list in GEOmetadb::geoConvert().

out_type

character. Accession types to return.

Value

A tibble with one column per input type present and per out_type, with one row per distinct combination. NA where an accession has no link of that type.

Details

Supported types: SRA study (SRP/ERP/DRP), sample (SRS/ERS/DRS), experiment (SRX/ERX/DRX) and run (SRR/ERR/DRR); biosample (SAMN/SAMEA/SAMD); bioproject (PRJNA/PRJEB/PRJDB); and GEO gse, gsm and gpl. SRA accessions are linked through runs (sradb.sra), so experiments without runs are not found, and GEO samples link to SRA through their SRA experiment. Converting a GPL returns every sample on that platform, which can be large.

Examples

con <- omicidx_connect()
sra_convert(con, "SRP000001")
#> # A tibble: 83 × 4
#>    study     sample    experiment run      
#>    <chr>     <chr>     <chr>      <chr>    
#>  1 SRP000001 SRS000100 SRX000006  SRR000002
#>  2 SRP000001 SRS000605 SRX000002  SRR000004
#>  3 SRP000001 SRS000100 SRX000004  SRR000006
#>  4 SRP000001 SRS000605 SRX000002  SRR000017
#>  5 SRP000001 SRS000100 SRX000006  SRR000022
#>  6 SRP000001 SRS000605 SRX000002  SRR000023
#>  7 SRP000001 SRS000605 SRX000002  SRR000030
#>  8 SRP000001 SRS000100 SRX000005  SRR000039
#>  9 SRP000001 SRS000100 SRX000005  SRR000041
#> 10 SRP000001 SRS000100 SRX000005  SRR000042
#> # ℹ 73 more rows
geo_convert(con, "GSE164073", c("gsm", "run"))
#> # A tibble: 72 × 3
#>    run         gse       gsm       
#>    <chr>       <chr>     <chr>     
#>  1 SRR13332246 GSE164073 GSM4996085
#>  2 SRR13332251 GSE164073 GSM4996086
#>  3 SRR13332256 GSE164073 GSM4996087
#>  4 SRR13332258 GSE164073 GSM4996088
#>  5 SRR13332259 GSE164073 GSM4996088
#>  6 SRR13332261 GSE164073 GSM4996088
#>  7 SRR13332262 GSE164073 GSM4996089
#>  8 SRR13332270 GSE164073 GSM4996091
#>  9 SRR13332273 GSE164073 GSM4996091
#> 10 SRR13332282 GSE164073 GSM4996094
#> # ℹ 62 more rows
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
